concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Concept low broad flattened opening and roof mass useful; remove photoreal texture, excessive loose-rock pile and implied enormous cave. Model continuous full-volume arch roof/walls with varying external profile and a real short tunnel, then a modeled rear wall beyond visible interior. Floor slopes modestly inward with low frozen flow ridges integrated in the mesh; no secondary overlaid coplanar slabs. Irregular basalt facets and muted weathered patches. Keep exterior low and wide, entrance opening visible from front/hero with side/top showing substantial roof not free bridge.
